scope: Independent-column full-raw-frame Arnoldi on the IDENTICAL LEGACY frozen-stage full346 benchmark; not physical joint dynamics, band truncation, nonlinear evolution or a speedup claim.
construction: One independent full-row Arnoldi space per original column, including linearly dependent original columns. Zero original columns retain their index and exact zero output. No cross-column orthogonalization, rank truncation, saved-band reduction or Gram repair.
Normalize each nonzero original column only internally: beta_j=norm(Psi_j), q_j0=Psi_j/beta_j; restore raw beta_j in every output. No change to original complex D.

Store bounded Q_j and HQ_j; twice reorthogonalize each latest Hq_j within its own column space. Batch accepted independent directions into ONE full-PW exact fused H action through the existing counted wrapper. Work cap counts every newly requested vector column before calling H.

Reuse authenticated retained H*Psi only after exact original frame/D/input bindings, unchanged historical operator module bytes and AST-identical legacy stage/build definitions are checked. A public kernel identity label alone does not authenticate a callable.
Use finite real shifts mu_j=Re(q_j0*Hq_j0) with exact-arithmetic phase exp(-i*t*mu_j). T_j=Q_j*(HQ_j-mu_j Q_j), no silent Hermitization. Output_j=exp(-i*t*mu_j) Q_j exp(-i*t*T_j) beta_j e1.

The growing projected objects are only k_j by k_j, never (346*k) by (346*k). Numerical breakdown stops basis expansion only: all omitted directions remain in the full-row E_j residual and cannot assert convergence.

Each evaluated stage publishes all requested full-frame outputs, per-column defect/orthogonality/growth/envelope records, invariant diagnostics with untouched D, and actual retained SciPy comparison before another expansion. Optional final full-row Q/HQ retention permits reconstruction audits.

bound_mathematics.identity: For each column, Hs=H-mu I, T arbitrary, E=Hs Q-Q T, c=beta e1, r=Psi-Qc, A=-i sign(t) Hs, B=-i sign(t) T. Exact error = exp(A tau)r + integral_0^tau exp(A(tau-s)) (-i sign(t) E) exp(Bs)c ds, then unit-modulus shift phase. No orthogonality or Hermiticity assumption is needed.
bound_mathematics.initial_and_seed: Measured initial reconstruction norm ||Psi-beta q0|| is propagated with exp(g*tau). Reused HQ0 has an additional action defect bounded by (||Hpsi-beta HQ0||+M||Psi-beta q0||)/beta, conditional on supplied retained Hpsi and ambient ||H||<=M. This defect is added by a separate cheap integral envelope; finite precision is not hidden behind an exact seed relation.
bound_mathematics.decomposition: Compute all full-row E=HQ-mu Q-QT afresh; not just a terminal Arnoldi scalar. This captures decomposition/reorthogonalization/breakdown directions represented by the stored action. Thin QR of E is used only for residual products: L=max(1,||Q_E||2) R_E, delta=||E-Q_E R_E||F, so ||E y|| <= ||L y||+delta||y|| in exact arithmetic. Delta and the seed-action defect receive a separate norm envelope. No residual-Gram eigenvalue clipping.
bound_mathematics.growth: g>=||antiHerm(H)||2 bounds either signed ambient generator; real shifts do not change it. For B use b=max(0,lambda_max((B+B*)/2)) and h=||(B+B*)/2||2, retaining any non-Hermitian projected growth.
bound_mathematics.cell_taylor: On cell midpoint m, halfwidth d, y=exp(Bm)c: integral ||L exp(Bu)y|| du <= sum_{j=0}^{p-1} 2*d^(j+1)/(j+1)! ||L B^j y|| + 2*d^(p+1)/(p+1)! ||L B^p||F ||y|| exp(h*d). Multiply by exp(g*(tau-left)), sum cells, add exp(g*tau)||r|| and tau exp(max(g,b)*tau)||c||(delta+seed_defect). This is analytic Taylor integration, not a sampled quadrature promoted to a certificate.
bound_mathematics.cheap: exp(g*tau)||r|| + tau exp(max(g,b)*tau)||c|| (||E||F+seed_defect). Take the minimum of the two independent exact-arithmetic envelopes. Aggregate column bounds by Euclidean norm to obtain the full-frame Frobenius bound, irrespective of column overlaps and raw D.
bound_mathematics.qualification: Every matrix action, QR, eigenvalue, norm, exponential, residual subtraction, scalar phase and reconstruction is ordinary floating evaluation. The formulas/diagnostics are estimates, NOT interval certificates or guaranteed enclosures of all machine-rounding errors. H-action evaluation errors are not interval bounded; neither are expm or output reconstruction roundoff. Nonfinite results stay insufficient.

independent: Dense SciPy full-H expm at signed times, all original columns
Exact SymPy two-level evolution, Duhamel and real-shift compensation
Complex nonorthogonal and exactly dependent raw columns plus a zero column
Arbitrary nonorthogonal Q/non-Galerkin T with full-row defect and nonzero initial residual
Exact and deliberately premature numerical breakdown
oracle.execution: Root runs only after source settlement; implementation worker performs no build/lint/test/format or numerical run.

material.operator: Exactly the existing legacy common-Gamma prepared-reference frozen stage used by retained full346 fused Hpsi and SciPy exponential; explicitly NOT the newer physical-spatial all-source Hamiltonian.
material.scipy_comparison: Required authenticated successful retained full-PW SciPy frame with identical original frame/D/sector and frozen-stage inputs; its time must appear explicitly in --times. Actual full-frame Frobenius difference participates in the target verdict at that time.
material.result_schema: P254-column-frame-krylov-material-v1; status estimated_target_met or insufficient; stop_reason, immutable input/source bindings, stages with per-column diagnostics/times/analytic envelopes/actual SciPy error/raw-D invariants/retained output arrays, action calls and counts, memory plan/RSS, optional final basis arrays, explicit limitations.
material.budget_conclusion: The existing 3072 MiB numerical-array allowance supports the full18613x346 frame through per-column dimension9 under this conservative plan; dimension10 is refused. Proposed dimension7 uses2704438464 bytes and2076 new H-vector columns after346 seed reuse. This does NOT establish fit inside the old4GiB process cgroup: material operator caches, Python/native allocators and OS/disk caches are additional; Root must allocate/measure process memory.
material.disk: Every evaluated stage retains all requested full frames; projected matrices are small. Final full-row Q/HQ arrays are optional --retain-final-basis. Disk space is not capped by --max-memory-mib.

limitations: One identical legacy frozen operator only; reuse invalid for changed electronic/ionic stage
Not physical joint dynamics, all-sector nonlinear propagation, loss, quantum advantage, long-time accuracy or speedup
No saved-band truncation, D refilling, Gram repair or Hermitian repair
Bounds are ordinary floating estimates, not interval certificates
Only numerical-array memory is bounded; total process memory and elapsed runtime require separate Root allocation
